card.name: Other drugs or products that share a property
card.fires_on: The noun or linking word right after 'other', 'or' or 'product' that begins a group of items defined by a shared ingredient or effect, as in 'with other drugs that may affect...'.

modes.label: other drugs
modes.description: The word 'drugs' after 'with other' in interaction warnings, before a clause describing a shared effect.
modes.example: caution is advised when venlafaxine hydrochloride extended-release capsules are coadministered with other<< drugs>> that may affect the serotonergic neurotrans

modes.label: product that contains
modes.description: 'that' or 'other' pointing to another product with the same active ingredient.
modes.example: not to use more than one product<< that>> contains acetaminophen.

modes.label: foods or medications
modes.description: A noun after 'or' that widens a list to other sources of a substance.
modes.example: The use of potassium-containing foods or<< medications>> must be eliminated.
